evidence.note: Front-loaded exploration of spec dirs, SIMD json files, and test-type counts — mapping the natural per-family/per-json structure before acting.
Repeated TodoWrite calls show an explicit, evolving milestone list maintained across the whole run rather than an undifferentiated push.
MVP i32 baseline run first, then value-type/decode/runtime infrastructure (v128) built before arithmetic families — sensible dependency ordering.
SIMD addressed family by family (pmin_pmax, f32x4 arith, conversions, simd_load) each localized to its matching spec-test json as a checkpoint.

Progression is largely failure-driven — repeatedly counting aggregate failure types and fixing the dominant category, rather than following a pre-declared ~15-family plan with per-family pass targets.

reasoning: The agent sequences MVP before SIMD, groups SIMD into families each checked against its matching spec_json, and goes further than the level-5 anchor by putting value-type/decode infrastructure first (dependency-aware) and maintaining an evolving todo list. However it stops short of level 8: the family ordering is emergent and reactive to failure-count analysis rather than an explicit dependency-mapped plan over all ~15 families with per-family pass targets, placing it between the 5 and 8 anchors.
